about: Translation catalogues and the problems a check finds in them, in the order it reports them. Run by both checkers: i18nextract.CheckTranslation (Go) and translationProblems() in scripts/i18n (Node), through TestTranslationCheckFixture. `translation` is the file's JSON value; `translationText`, when present, is its raw text instead. A null key is a problem with the file as a whole.

cases.name: a good catalogue, with untranslated and quoted entries

source.{kind, select, file {Delete the file?} o: {kind, select, file {Delete the file?} other {Delete the folder?}}

translation.{count, plural, one {# file} other {# fi: {count, plural, =0 {aucun fichier} one {# fichier} many {# de fichiers} other {# fichiers}}
translation.{kind, select, file {Delete the file?} o: {kind, select, file {Supprimer le fichier ?} other {Supprimer le dossier ?}}
